scoring_justification: Top tier recompute infeasible (verifier cannot re-run full DFT+DFPT+EPW workflow). All headline quantities are fixed deterministic physical properties, so result-level comparison with paper gold under tolerances is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for inter_ring_distance, fermi_level_DOS, lambda, Tc sourced from paper's PBE-D3(BJ) results. dynamic_stable gold is true.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: inter_ring_distance 3.38 Å (main text, 'calculates as 3.38 Å at the PBE-D3(BJ) level'). DOS 0.19 states/eV/atom (text: 'approximately 0.19 -0.27... depending on level of theory', 0.19 for PBE-D3). λ=0.3 ('relatively low electron-phonon coupling constant λ of 0.3'). Tc=0.5 K ('critical superconducting temperature, Tc of 0.5 K'). Dynamic stability confirmed (paper states no imaginary frequencies).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are explicitly reported in the paper under the same functional and conditions used by the reference solver; they are the paper's own claims.

outputs.description: Final computed scalar results (inter-ring distance, DOS at Fermi level, electron-phonon coupling constant, critical temperature) and the dynamical stability flag.

steps.description: Shortest distance between stacked C6O6 planes (Å). Gold is paper's PBE-D3(BJ) value. Tolerance accommodates PBE-D2 vs D3 dispersion.
Electronic DOS at Fermi level (states/eV/atom). Gold is the PBE-D3(BJ) lower bound; tolerance accounts for functional differences.
Electron-phonon coupling constant λ (dimensionless). Gold from paper's PBE-D3(BJ) calculation.
Superconducting critical temperature (K) from McMillan-Allen-Dynes with μ*=0.1. Gold from paper's PBE-D3(BJ). Tolerance allows for smearing convergence differences.
Dynamical stability flag: true if phonon spectrum has no imaginary modes. Paper finds no imaginary frequencies.
